scope: An adult in millennium-futurist fashion uses physical equipment in a complex indoor event.

scene_options.activity: aligning two overlapping patterned transparencies while turning the projector focus knob
scene_options.consequence: a sharply layered orbital diagram projected across the wall

scene_options.activity: turning a side handwheel while resting the other hand on the bench brace
scene_options.consequence: small pinpoints of stars spreading over a curved test wall

scene_options.activity: turning a large transport knob while guiding a loose tape loop past a visible tension roller
scene_options.consequence: a taut tape path and spinning reels next to a glowing analog meter

scene_options.device: a hand-cranked wind machine with a canvas drum
scene_options.activity: turning its crank while holding the stationary stand
scene_options.consequence: a ribbon tied to the test microphone fluttering in the generated airflow

scene_options.activity: turning a side wheel while holding the print bed handle
scene_options.consequence: a partly emerging bright orbital-pattern print

scene_options.device: an optical telescope on a manual test stand
scene_options.activity: turning a focusing wheel while holding the mount brace
scene_options.consequence: a projected concentric calibration pattern on a nearby screen
